doc.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Okay. Well thanks for your time today.
Oh man it was great, Monk, you made it very easy.
Good. Good. And I’ll be waiting to hear that chart this afternoon to see how it goes.
No it’s not today, tomorrow afternoon.
Swing 7, we’ve got about forty minutes to play and there’s a lot of stuff on there and the new chart for “Stompy Jones.” And you take care, man.
Thanks a lot. I appreciate it very much.
